title: NOAERTH resource contract (Phase 4B)

publisher.cadence: every 2 minutes (root cron: noaerth agentos governor snapshot --publish)
publisher.log: bounded summary lines only (no full JSON into syslog)

disk_growth.unit: bytes per day change in free space
sources: janitor space status --json forecast (trend=insufficient data -> UNKNOWN)
autonomousos scheduler demands SUM(active_workers) - authoritative registry
agentos host_governor evaluate (hysteresis applied there, never here)

unknown_semantics.rule: A source that cannot be read yields UNKNOWN, never a fabricated sample. UNKNOWN is fail-closed for capacity and admission.

capacity.initial_concurrency: at most 2 additional heavyweight coding workers (MAX_ADDITIONAL_HEAVY_CODING=2)
matrix: PRESSED or RECOVERING + same -> 1 (slowed admissions; band is hysteresis-held)
CRITICAL or band=UNKNOWN or aos_allow=false or storage DENY/UNKNOWN or stacking/stuck scan -> 0
capacity.never: raise an existing cap (mesh DEFAULT_CAPS cpu_heavy=2 base stays authoritative); never start/stop/kill a worker; never modify another agent's task state

admission.fail_closed: missing/stale (>180s)/UNKNOWN snapshot refuses with honest reason + bounded retry_after_s
admission.fail_open_only_for: Consumers that cannot read the snapshot file at all fall back to the pre-existing gates (Hive execution.py gate, host governor admission). The snapshot gate never replaces them.
admission.hysteresis: taken from the host governor band only; admission adds no second hysteresis loop

pressure_response.cpu_saturation: band falls via governor -> capacity 1 then 0; heavy deferred
pressure_response.memory: memory_pressure field reports PSI; CRITICAL band refuses
pressure_response.disk: storage_admission DENY refuses; disk_free/disk_growth reported from JanitorOS
pressure_response.worker_stacking: janitor_processes>2 or disk_watch_processes>1 -> stacking_detected, capacity 0, refuse
pressure_response.failed_cron_environment: janitor unreadable -> storage_admission UNKNOWN -> refuse (fail closed)
pressure_response.stuck_filesystem_scans: find processes older than 600s counted; >0 -> capacity 0, refuse
pressure_response.provider_rate_limit: studio kv provider_wait:<epoch> active -> provider_cooldown refusal regardless of host health; healthy host does not override a cooling provider and vice versa
pressure_response.verification_overload: active test leases >= test cap (3) -> verification profile refused; heavy/light unaffected (admission-only rule)

scratch_leases.mechanism: existing JanitorOS: janitor space scratch register|complete|reap
scratch_leases.retention: disposable -> reap requested on completion; rollback_critical/evidence -> retained, never requested for reaping

consumers.mesh/hive/execution.py: reads published snapshot; present+fresh and band CRITICAL -> refuse manifest (serveros_band_critical); PRESSED/RECOVERING -> defer LOW-level manifests only (HIGH/CRITICAL pass, default MEDIUM unaffected); absent/stale -> skip this gate (pre-existing gate still governs)
consumers.mesh/health.py doctor: additive resource_health top-level key (O(1) file read)
consumers.api GET /resource: read-only O(1) read of published file

freshness.stale_meaning: UNKNOWN for admission; consumers fall back to their pre-existing gates

non_goals: modifying another agent's task or worktree
